title: E&S Review project lifecycle business exchange and proposed domain definitions
description: Root validates only the additive account-owned limited business ledger. Local command/import/report and minimized institution read-projection definitions describe implemented protocol shapes. Full E&S domain and interoperability definitions labeled proposed or existing-authority projection are design contracts, not new runtime stores or accepted ledger collections. Existing Project, Engagement, source/evidence, framework and approval authorities remain intact. Shape validation does not replace transactional graph validation, current authorization, retained-source verification or human professional decisions.

ApplicationId.description: Stable opaque application identifier. New entities use UUIDs; retain exact legacy IDs. Never derive identity from name.

ProjectIdentityId.description: Existing real-world identity UUID from project-identities.mjs.

Timestamp.description: Exact ISO UTC instant with milliseconds; distinguish when an event occurred, when it was assessed, and when it was recorded.

LedgerRevision.description: Ledger starts empty at revision zero; entity record revisions and audit sequence start at one.

Decimal.description: Exact nonnegative base-10 value with at most 18 integer and 12 fractional digits, never binary floating point.

Percent.description: Exact percentage from zero through 100, up to six decimal places. Aggregated percentage constraints require semantic validation.

Money.description: ISO 4217 code; no implicit exchange-rate conversion. Currency validity and minor units require registry validation.

ExternalReference.description: Namespaced institutional identifier or alias. An external identifier does not grant ownership or merge entities.

ExactSourceVersion.description: Locator into existing project resource/version authority. Verify project/resource/version closure and full-object SHA256 before use. The version remains owned by its existing authority; no file bytes, local paths, signed URLs or grants appear here.

ExistingRecordReference.description: Existing engagement-owned entity; type is determined by the referring field. A pinned revision may resolve the current row or its retained row.history under current access authority. Historical role/grant origin is not established by that lookup. Exact revisions are required for frozen assessment inputs; source hashes remain in existing evidence authority.

ExtensionValue.description: Registered namespace + pinned schema version; validate payload against that registered schema. No executable code, secrets, transport credentials, authority overrides or alternate core relationships.

RecordEnvelope.description: Business record metadata for proposed extension records. Existing engagement records retain their existing envelope and are referenced, not rewritten.

ProjectBinding.description: References existing account project and explicit real-world identity link. No project title or parallel project authority.

LedgerContext.description: Existing account custody UUID. Account selection in local mode is not remote multi-user authentication.

ProjectComponent.description: Physical or functional project component, optionally nested or an associated facility. Associated facilities are explicit relationships, never implicit shared ownership.

Site.description: Spatially located operational or study area; detailed geometry remains a versioned spatial source.

Activity.description: A time-bounded undertaking such as site clearing, construction, operation or decommissioning. Optional sectorProfileId links the existing application sector profile only after manual business verification; it is neither an institutional risk category nor a compliance/applicability conclusion.

Organization.description: Named legal or institutional organization, including financiers, funds, intermediaries, operators and community bodies. Descriptive organization identity grants no account access.

OrganizationRoleAssignment.description: Effective-dated business role linking an organization to explicit project, component, investment, facility or agreement scopes. Separate from professional assignment and access grants.

Investment.description: Investor economic interest that may target an organization, fund or intermediary; allocations independently connect its amount to one or several project/component identities.

FinancialFacility.description: Contractual financing envelope distinct from Investment and from individual financial transactions; supports parent facilities and credit lines.

Transaction.description: One dated financial commitment, flow or reversal; retains original money and currency without silently converting totals.

FinancingParticipant.description: Organization participation in a particular facility, permitting separate lenders and financiers with distinct roles, shares and commitments.

InvestmentAllocation.description: Normalized many-to-many allocation of an Investment across projects and optionally components. Amount or share is explicit; unallocated balances and currency conversions remain visible.

Agreement.description: Versioned contract connecting parties, projects and facilities; sourceVersions pin exact retained contract editions and amendments.

Covenant.description: Agreement obligation with its exact source passage and links to existing requirements and monitoring obligations. A covenant record does not make a compliance finding.

EngagementScope.description: Structured scope overlay for an existing professional Engagement across project parts and periods. Existing mandates, roles and sources remain authoritative.

RequirementApplicability.description: Explicit professional applicability decision for a pinned existing requirement/framework edition at project, component, financing, agreement and temporal scope. Never inherited through a crosswalk.

LifecycleEvent.description: Lifecycle stage or milestone referencing existing engagement, monitoring cycle, incident/event, action and approved baseline records. Does not copy observations, facts or compliance conclusions.

LedgerEntities.description: Only these 15 collections are writable in the limited local implementation. Other $defs are proposed design contracts and are not accepted as runtime collections.

LedgerSnapshot.description: Immutable business-context content only. Excludes recursive history, audit and approvals; never an approved E&S assessment or evidence/source access grant.

LedgerAuditCommand.description: Bounded command summary cryptographically binds the actual resulting ledger snapshot. Does not copy user proposal data or sensitive sources into audit.

ProjectLifecycleExchange.description: Additive account-owned business ledger. All projects, engagements, evidence and source versions resolve through existing authorities. JSON Schema verifies shape; runtime must enforce foreign keys, authorization, temporal order, decimal sums, CAS, complete histories, digest identity and graph closure.

AuthorityReference.description: Adapter-compatible shared ResourceReference; always validate with workspace-contracts assertResourceReference. Descriptive reference only, never a transport or authorization grant.

ImmutableAuthorityReference.description: Exact-version shared ResourceReference. Required for frozen source/requirement crosswalk and approved projection inputs. Current authorization remains external.

Quantity.description: Exact measurement value with explicit UCUM-compatible unit; units, detection limits and conversions are validated in discipline profiles.

Threshold.description: Threshold uses its exact legal, permit or framework source and units. Temporal applicability and comparator bounds require semantic checks.

SourcePassage.description: Exact passage in the existing retained original. OCR/extracted candidates must preserve derivative identity and original-page review in existing extraction binding. Quote hashing does not prove meaning or professional sufficiency.

Project.description: Projection of the existing real-world Project identity; business references never create a second project authority.

Engagement.description: Projection reference to existing contractual professional mandate, independent of financing and project identity.

Deliverable.description: Structured expected professional output; implementation initially maps existing engagement mandate deliverables and obligation/publication records.

Risk.description: Uncertain potential adverse environmental or social event or condition; preserve inherent and residual risk separately.

Impact.description: Expected or observed change to a receptor caused by an activity, distinguishing adverse and beneficial impacts.

Receptor.description: Environmental or social receptor such as habitat, water body, workers, community or cultural asset; do not expose sensitive coordinates in public views.

StakeholderGroup.description: Affected or interested group with scoped vulnerability characterization; individual identities remain in restricted case storage.

BaselineCondition.description: Dated, sourced description of a receptor before change; keep season, method and uncertainty explicit.

ManagementPlan.description: Versioned management instrument linking risks, requirements, measures, responsibilities and resources.

ManagementMeasure.description: One mitigation or enhancement measure in the mitigation hierarchy with owner, schedule, budget and verification criteria.

FrameworkEdition.description: Versioned attributable institutional framework or statutory instrument, independent of report-template editions.

Requirement.description: Attributable requirement or explicitly labeled review prompt; existing retained catalogue definitions remain authoritative for current engagements.

RequirementCrosswalk.description: Reviewed versioned mapping between exact requirement editions. Relationships describe meaning and never propagate applicability or compliance conclusions.

Study.description: Study metadata and scope referencing existing original document editions; field methods and limitations are explicit.

EvidenceAssertion.description: Reference projection of existing engagement assertion. A source statement and its reliability are separate from the project fact or assessor judgment it may support.

Observation.description: Directly recorded dated observation without a professional conclusion; retains original field/measurement evidence and QA state.

ProfessionalJudgment.description: Attributable assessor interpretation using explicit evidence, contradictions, rubric and uncertainty. AI proposals cannot sign or establish a conclusion.

ProjectFact.description: Scoped proposition explicitly established by an authorized human on retained evidence; retains disputed or corrected predecessor without erasure.

Indicator.description: Typed environmental or social indicator definition. Thresholds and outcome targets retain source and period; cross-project aggregation requires comparable units and denominators.

IndicatorMeasurement.description: Dated site and period value for an indicator with sampling method, worker class, uncertainty, QA and exact source evidence.

SocialOutcome.description: Measured social result against a specified baseline and affected group, without inferring causality from a trend.

Grievance.description: Restricted case metadata with receipt, acknowledgment, response, appeal and closure; individual content is held by existing restricted case authority.

IncidentNotification.description: Notice sent to a specifically identified recipient under a sourced reporting obligation; timestamps do not infer that another recipient was notified.

Incident.description: Existing restricted E&S event with occurrence, awareness and per-recipient notification times; redacted public metadata never expose victims or sensitive geometry.

Assessment.description: Repeated or overlapping professional evaluation over an explicit scope and period with pinned requirement editions, sources and immutable approved baseline.

AssessmentFinding.description: Projection reference of existing engagement finding; applicability, evidence coverage, adequacy and performance remain distinct judgments.

CorrectiveAction.description: Projection/extension of existing action with responsible organization, linked deficiencies, deadlines, budget, dependencies and evidence-based verification.

Commitment.description: Project promise arising from a plan, consultation or contract, independently tracked from the corrective action used to deliver it.

Verification.description: Projection reference of existing independent verification against explicit criteria, retained closure evidence and authorized reviewer.

Approval.description: Existing authorized professional process decision tied to a fixed content revision/hash. Business-context approval is separately typed and does not imply assessment approval.

MonitoringProgram.description: Existing monitoring program reusing its approved assessment baseline, requirements, indicators, actions and obligations.

MonitoringCycle.description: Existing periodic supervision cycle; cycles can overlap but remain independently reviewed against exact periods and baseline snapshots.

Report.description: Issued existing publication rendition or proposed template view of exact baseline content; rendering never becomes a second record authority.

ConsultationEvent.description: Dated meaningful engagement and disclosure event retaining accessibility, SEP deviations, feedback and responses without publishing personal identities.

PortfolioExposure.description: Dated original-currency intermediary/fund exposure by product and sector, retaining estimated status and denominator before aggregation.

Entitlement.description: Eligibility and benefit owed under an exact approved resettlement/compensation instrument; personal roster stays restricted.

EntitlementDelivery.description: Scheduled and actual entitlement delivery with retained evidence and human verification; payment does not establish livelihood restoration.

LivelihoodOutcome.description: Longitudinal livelihood result relative to baseline with subgroup disaggregation and attribution limitations.

FactValue.description: Atomic typed fact value; scoped relationships remain explicit references/fields rather than arbitrary nested project graphs. Unknown values remain null with explicit status/basis.

ProvenanceInput.description: Proposal provenance only. Actor/time/review status and reviewer fields are server owned and forbidden in command inputs.

BatchCommand.description: Only project selection and proposal upserts may be batched. Verification and business approval are separate explicit human decisions.

LifecycleCommandRequest.description: Implemented trusted-local command envelope. actorId is local attribution, not an authenticated remote principal. CAS expectedRevision must equal current ledger revision.

LifecycleImportRequest.description: Implemented local restore. Only an empty same-account ledger or exact replay is accepted; divergent retained histories are not silently merged. Imported verification does not create this installation's local verification receipt.

PortfolioView.description: Bounded original-currency leaf allocations; parent/intermediary and child exposure are not added twice. This is not the total legal commitment, a net asset value or a native institutional report.

LifecycleReport.description: Implemented bounded report projection. asOf selects financial allocation effective date only; assessment context explicitly pins a retained approved baseline or current working review, with separate projection/dataset hashes. It does not reconstruct all past knowledge. Institutional output is a partial minimized field exchange, not a completed native template, professional acceptance or compliance conclusion. Exact current source references include provenance, agreement, covenant and geometry pins; source bytes remain in existing authority.

RestoreReceipt.description: Installation-local import receipt stored separately from the imported ledger and existing assessment approval history.

LifecycleDomainEvent.description: PROPOSED only: optional future after-commit event/outbox contract. No event transport, hosted worker, queue consumer or recurring schedule is enabled.

ProjectionText.description: Existing-authority read projection text, allowing an explicitly retained empty legacy value. Never interpreted as executable content.

ReportTemporalScope.description: asOf filters financial allocation validity only. Assessment input is an explicitly retained baseline or current working review; no full historical knowledge or bitemporal reconstruction is claimed.

AssessmentContextProjection.description: Exact source baseline is verified before authorized disclosure/period filtering. projectionSha256 identifies the resulting projection and is never relabeled as the original approved baseline hash.
